1.q: How do I book tickets on Travelita?
1.a: Choose transport mode (Plane, Bus, or Ferry), enter origin & destination city, date, and number of passengers, then click Search Tickets. After getting results, select the matching ticket and make payment.

2.a: Refund policy depends on the airline/operator. Generally, flexible tickets can be refunded up to 24 hours before departure with an admin fee of Rp 25,000.

3.q: How long does it take to receive the e-ticket after payment?
3.a: E-ticket will be sent to your email within a maximum of 15 minutes after payment is confirmed.

4.q: Are there additional fees besides the ticket price?
4.a: Ticket prices include tax and basic service fees. Additional baggage fees and paid seat selection will be displayed transparently before payment.

5.q: Can I book tickets for someone else?
5.a: Yes. When filling in passenger data, enter a different name and details from the booker. Make sure the data matches the identity used during travel.

1.q: Does the price include fuel and tolls?
1.a: No. Fuel and toll costs are borne by the renter. The driver will provide toll receipts for transparency.

2.q: Can I choose the same driver as before?
2.a: Yes! Contact our CS and we will arrange the same driver if available on your schedule.

3.q: What happens if the trip exceeds the booked duration?
3.a: Extensions are charged at overtime rate of Rp 50,000/hour. Confirm with the driver or our CS first.

4.q: Is late night or early morning service available?
4.a: Available 24 hours. Bookings outside working hours (22:00–06:00) are subject to a surcharge of Rp 75,000.

5.q: What if the car has issues during the trip?
5.a: We provide a replacement vehicle within 60 minutes in major city areas. All replacement costs are covered by Travelita.

1.q: Do I need to know how to swim to join spear fishing?
1.a: Yes, basic swimming ability is required. For beginner packages, we provide a special instructor and life vest. Participants do not need previous diving experience.

2.q: Is spear fishing equipment included in the package?
2.a: Yes, all packages include basic equipment rental (mask, fins, snorkel). Spearguns & wetsuits are included for Intermediate package and above. You can also bring your own equipment.

3.q: What is the minimum age to join a spear fishing trip?
3.a: Minimum participant age is 14 years. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by an adult guardian and have written parental consent.

4.q: What happens if there's bad weather on trip day?
4.a: Safety is our priority. If sea conditions are not suitable, the trip will be rescheduled at no extra cost, or 100% refund if rescheduling is not possible.

5.q: Can I take the catch home?
5.a: Catch will be cooked for lunch together (Intermediate & Professional packages). For Beginner packages, catch is catch-and-release for ecosystem conservation.

1.q: Does the price include flights to Lombok?
1.a: No. The listed price is for the Lombok tour package only, not including flights to Lombok. We can help find the best flight tickets if you need them.

2.q: What is the minimum age for Rinjani trekking?
2.a: Minimum age for Rinjani trekking is 17 years with prime physical condition. Summit climbing is highly recommended for those accustomed to hiking. There is also a lighter lakeside camping route for ages 14 and above.

3.q: Can packages be customized for groups or families?
3.a: Of course! All packages can be adjusted for groups, families, or honeymoon events. Contact our team to get special group pricing (min. 10 people).

4.q: What is the cancellation and refund policy?
4.a: Cancellation 7 days before departure: 100% refund. Cancellation 3–6 days before: 50% refund. Cancellation less than 3 days: no refund, but can be rescheduled.

5.q: What should I bring when joining a tour package?
5.a: Identity documents (ID/passport), appropriate clothing (swimwear for beach/Gili, warm clothes for Rinjani), sunscreen, hat, and camera. Each package has a complete packing list that will be sent after booking confirmation.
